pattern.short_summary: The object the user is authoring is instantiated as a conversational agent, and the user develops it by talking to it in character rather than by editing a representation of it.
pattern.definition: The object the user is authoring is instantiated as a conversational agent, and the user develops it by talking to it in character rather than by editing a representation of it. Answers the agent gives become part of the object's specification. Editing and testing collapse into the same act.
pattern.structural_signature: The work object's current specification is bound to an agent's conditioning; the user's only interaction surface with that object is dialogue with the agent so conditioned; the agent's replies are treated as further content of the object, feeding back into the specification. Structurally: the artifact's state and the interlocutor's state are the same state, and there is no separate editable rendering of the object. Transplants wherever an artifact can be voiced — a product spec interviewed as a "customer", a policy queried as itself.

dimension.category_description: How human and artificial participants are personified, assigned visible roles, coordinated, simulated, or represented to one another.
dimension.classification_boundary: Identity or social organization must be user-facing; invisible multi-agent division of labor is excluded.

candidates.title: CharacterMeet: Supporting Creative Writers' Entire Story Character Construction Processes Through Conversation with LLM-Powered Chatbot Avatars

evidence.quote: we explore how conversation with chatbot avatars embodying characters powered by more recent technologies could support the entire character construction process for creative writing

candidates.title: AI-Driven Co-Construction of Synthetic Personas for Early-Stage B2B User Research: An Exploratory Study

evidence.quote: We developed a conversational agent prototype that supports generating and conversing with synthetic personas for early-stage B2B user research where access to client practitioners and domain information is limited.
